title: Comparative Evaluation of LLM-Based Review Paradigms for Academic Paper Quality Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2610.41391v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Growing submission volumes have renewed interest in using large language models (LLMs) to support peer review. It remains unclear how such evaluation should be structured, how much the model matters, and whether LLM scores predict research impact. We evaluate five paradigms across three input representations and three LLMs on 232 stratified ICLR 2025 submissions. Direct absolute rating matches comparative ranking on rank correlation with human scores, yet compresses most predictions above the accept threshold, flagging almost none of the papers reviewers scored below it. A base-rate-matched recalibration control locates the cause: comparative ranking supplies placement, not better ordering, and after recalibration Direct Rating reaches higher agreement than Elo while making 24% as many API calls. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的学术论文质量评估评审范式的比较评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.41391v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：投稿量的持续增长重新激发了人们利用大语言模型（LLM）辅助同行评审的兴趣。然而，此类评估应如何组织构建、模型本身有多重要、以及LLM评分能否预测研究影响力，目前仍不明确。我们在232篇分层抽样的ICLR 2025投稿上，跨三种输入表示和三种LLM评估了五种范式。直接绝对评分在与人类评分的秩相关性上与比较排序表现相当，但其大部分预测被压缩至接收阈值之上，几乎无法标记出评审人评分低于阈值的论文。通过基准率匹配的重新校准控制实验，我们定位了原因：比较排序提供的是位置信息而非更优的排序；重新校准后，直接评分比Elo方法达到更高的一致性，同时API调用量仅为后者的24%。仅使用摘要的输入优于基于全文的摘要化，且模型选择与范式选择同等重要。在全部11,513篇有评分投稿上的复现实验……（原文截断）
tldr: 该研究系统比较了五种基于LLM的论文评审范式，发现重新校准后的直接绝对评分能以仅24%的API调用量取得优于Elo比较排序的人类评分一致性，且仅用摘要输入以及模型选择的影响与范式选择同等重要。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates five LLM-based review paradigms, showing that recalibrated Direct Rating achieves higher human agreement than Elo comparative ranking with only 24% of the API calls, while abstract-only input and model choice matter as much as paradigm choice.
